description: Sections for the 'show' command. Each entry is picked via fzf and its command's output is printed in the terminal. Add new entries here to extend 'show' without touching scripts/show.sh.

sections.label: hosts
sections.description: List /etc/hosts entries (alias, then IP address; column-aligned)
sections.command: awk '{ if ($0 ~ /^#/ || NF==0) { lines[NR]=$0; type[NR]="c"; next } ip=$1; rest=$0; sub($1 FS,"",rest); gsub(/^[ \t]+/,"",rest); lines[NR]=rest; ips[NR]=ip; type[NR]="d"; if (length(rest)>w) w=length(rest) } END{ for (i=1;i<=NR;i++) { if (type[i]=="c") print lines[i]; else printf "%-*s  %s\n", w, lines[i], ips[i] } }' /etc/hosts
